repository.note: The default repository for spack packages

namespace_definition.note: The spack namespace as given by `spack find -N`

version_definition.note: The spack version using the standard version syntax (https://spack.readthedocs.io/en/latest/spec_syntax.html#version-specifier)

qualifiers_definition.description: The spack hash of the installation as given by 'spack find -l'
